c2pa.headline2: the standard adopted by global leaders.
c2pa.description: The Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA) brings together Adobe, Microsoft, Google, Apple, BBC, Sony, Reuters and dozens more. IronID implements this open standard to guarantee universal interoperability.
c2pa.trustDesc: A file certified with IronID can be verified by any C2PA-compatible tool — Adobe Content Credentials, Microsoft Azure, Google, or directly at verify.contentauthenticity.org. No vendor lock-in.

hero.badge: The reference standard for digital authenticity
hero.subtitle: IronID certifies your images, videos and documents with a cryptographic C2PA signature and records them in an immutable ledger — publicly verifiable, forever.

steps.title: Upload your file
steps.description: Send any file via our REST API or JS/Python SDKs. We accept images, videos, PDFs and audio up to 100 MB.

steps.title: C2PA Signature & Ledger
steps.description: IronID computes the SHA-256, builds a C2PA manifest, signs with ECDSA P-256 and writes everything to an immutable PostgreSQL ledger protected by Row-Level Security.

steps.title: Public verification
steps.description: Anyone can verify a file's authenticity via the public URL or by uploading the file directly — no account required.

items.title: C2PA Signature
items.desc: Open standard by the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity. Interoperable with Adobe, Microsoft, Google.

items.title: Immutable ledger
items.desc: PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security — UPDATE and DELETE blocked at the database level. No rollback possible.

items.title: Async processing
items.desc: Certification via BackgroundTasks. Webhook callbacks or polling. No HTTP timeout on the client side.

items.title: Official SDK
items.desc: JavaScript/TypeScript and Python SDKs with strict types, error handling and automatic retry.

items.title: Public verification
items.desc: Shareable verification URL. Anyone can prove or disprove a file's authenticity.
